});

    ipVersion: "IPv4",
});
const exampleListener = new tencentcloud.ga2.Listener("example", {
    globalAcceleratorId: exampleAccelerateArea.globalAcceleratorId,
    name: "tf-example-http",
    protocol: "HTTP",

        fromPort: 90,
        toPort: 90,
    },

    requestTimeout: 60,
    listenerType: "Standard",

});
const exampleEndpointGroup = new tencentcloud.ga2.EndpointGroup("example", {

        endpointGroupRegion: "ap-guangzhou",

        enableHealthCheck: true,
        forwardProtocol: "HTTP",
        checkType: "HTTP",

        checkMethod: "GET",

            "http_4xx",

                endpointType: "CustomPublicIp",

                weight: 10,
            },
            {
                endpointType: "CustomDomain",

                weight: 20,
            },
        ],
        portOverrides: [{
            listenerPort: 90,
            endpointPort: 9090,
        }],
    },
});
const exampleForwardingPolicy = new tencentcloud.ga2.ForwardingPolicy("example", {

});
const exampleForwardingRule = new tencentcloud.ga2.ForwardingRule("example", {
    globalAcceleratorId: exampleAccelerateArea.globalAcceleratorId,

			EndpointGroupConfiguration: &ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationArgs{
				Name:                pulumi.String("tf-example"),
				EndpointGroupRegion: pulumi.String("ap-guangzhou"),

					pulumi.String("http_3xx"),
					pulumi.String("http_4xx"),
				},
				EndpointConfigurations: ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArray{
					&ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArgs{
						EndpointType:    pulumi.String("CustomPublicIp"),
						EndpointService: pulumi.String("1.1.1.1"),
						Weight:          pulumi.Int(10),
					},
					&ga2.EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArgs{
						EndpointType:    pulumi.String("CustomDomain"),
						EndpointService: pulumi.String("example.com"),
						Weight:          pulumi.Int(20),

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var example = new GlobalAccelerator("example", GlobalAcceleratorArgs.builder()

                .fromPort(90)

            .globalAcceleratorId(example.id())
            .listenerId(exampleListener.listenerId())
            .endpointGroupType("VIRTUAL")
            .endpointGroupConfiguration(EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationArgs.builder()
                .name("tf-example")
                .endpointGroupRegion("ap-guangzhou")
                .description("tf example endpoint group")
                .enableHealthCheck(true)
                .forwardProtocol("HTTP")
                .checkType("HTTP")
                .checkDomain("check.com")
                .checkMethod("GET")
                .checkPath("/path")
                .connectTimeout(2)
                .healthCheckInterval(30)
                .healthyThreshold(3)
                .unhealthyThreshold(3)
                .statusMasks(                
                    "http_2xx",
                    "http_3xx",
                    "http_4xx")
                .endpointConfigurations(                
                    EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArgs.builder()
                        .endpointType("CustomPublicIp")
                        .endpointService("1.1.1.1")
                        .weight(10)
                        .build(),
                    EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationEndpointConfigurationArgs.builder()
                        .endpointType("CustomDomain")
                        .endpointService("example.com")
                        .weight(20)
                        .build())
                .portOverrides(EndpointGroupEndpointGroupConfigurationPortOverrideArgs.builder()
                    .listenerPort(90)
                    .endpointPort(9090)
                    .build())
                .build())
            .build());

        var exampleForwardingPolicy = new ForwardingPolicy("exampleForwardingPolicy", ForwardingPolicyArgs.builder()

## Import



GA2 forwarding rule can be imported using the composite id `<global_accelerator_id>#<listener_id>#<forwarding_policy_id>#<forwarding_rule_id>`, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Ga2/forwardingRule:ForwardingRule example ga-fhhs8w84#lsr-dyy8jhzp#dm-rjssxr8k#rule-757r3bk2
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
